target.title: fix(qa-lab): cancel unread response body in parity tool-call fetch
target.body:
## Summary

Fixes #109991

**What changed**: Added `await response.body?.cancel().catch(() => undefined)` before returning null on non-ok HTTP responses in `loadRuntimeParityMockToolCalls`. When the QA Lab runtime parity endpoint returns a non-ok status (e.g. 503, 400, 500), the response body stream is now explicitly cancelled before returning null, preventing an unread stream resource leak.

**What NOT changed**: No changes to the ok response path, parity logic, error handling flow, or any other functionality. No new dependencies or configuration options added.

**merge-risk**: Minimal — one-line addition of a well-established pattern with no configuration changes, no new dependencies, and no impact on the ok response path. The `.catch(() => undefined)` makes it safe even in edge-case stream states.

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed**: Body cancel on non-ok HTTP response in QA Lab runtime parity mock tool-call fetch path.

**Real environment tested**: Live QA Lab runtime-parity module via HTTP mock server (127.0.0.1) exercising `captureRuntimeParityCell` with non-ok responses from the `debug/requests` endpoint.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**:
```
npx vitest run extensions/qa-lab/src/runtime-parity-body-cancel.evidence.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

**After-fix evidence**:
```
 RUN  v4.1.10

 ✓ runtime-parity body cancel evidence > cancels body and returns transcript-only result on 503 from mock endpoint 257ms
 ✓ runtime-parity body cancel evidence > handles 400 Bad Request without crashing 78ms
 ✓ runtime-parity body cancel evidence > handles 500 Internal Server Error without crashing 75ms
 ✓ runtime-parity body cancel evidence > gracefully handles null mockBaseUrl (skips mock fetch entirely) 74ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  4 passed (4)
```

**Observed result after the fix**: All 4 evidence tests pass:
1. 503 response → body cancelled, transcript-only fallback result returned
2. 400 response → body cancelled, no crash
3. 500 response → body cancelled, no crash
4. null mockBaseUrl → no fetch attempted, clean path

Existing 16 runtime-parity tests also pass with no regression:
```
 ✓ |extension-qa| runtime-parity.test.ts 16/16
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  20 passed (20)
```

**What was not tested**: Full integration test against a live QA Lab runtime endpoint (requires configured runtime parity server). The HTTP mock server approach exercises the exact changed code path with real Response/body objects.

## Tests and validation

- `extensions/qa-lab/src/runtime-parity-body-cancel.evidence.test.ts` — 4 new evidence tests
- `extensions/qa-lab/src/runtime-parity.test.ts` — 16 existing tests, all pass

## Risk checklist

- [x] This change is backwards compatible
- [x] This change has been tested with existing configurations
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation
- [ ] Breaking changes (if any) are documented in Summary
